title: Mixing, editing: Jet, Mrs Vandebilt, Let Me Roll It by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

A stereo mixing session for the Band On The Run songs ‘Jet’, ‘Mrs Vandebilt’, and ‘Let Me Roll It’ took place on 27 October 1973.

The session began at 2pm and ended at 4am the following morning. It was the first of three mixing sessions held at Abbey Road.

Studio engineer Geoff Emerick mixed ‘Jet’, with the final version an edit of RS4 and RS5.

‘Mrs Vandebilt’ was completed in just one attempt, and ‘Let Me Roll It’ in three.
